input_contract.anchor: q-8, true finite observation required per feature
input_contract.estimated_points: q-7 through q inclusive, relative to anchor horizons 1..8
input_contract.coordinates: asinh((feature - fixed source model center) / fixed source model scale)
input_contract.comparisons: identical finite anchor/target cells for every method; no label cropping
input_contract.complete_case: all 8 channels at anchor and all 8 pending timestamps finite

methods.hold_anchor: same-channel true value at q-8, held across the 8 pending points
methods.damped_trend: anchor + clip(0.25*(z[q-8]-z[q-16])*h/8, -0.25, 0.25); if q-16 unavailable use anchor; fixed before data read

input_contract.shot_aggregation: mean absolute error over comparable channel-time cells within each shot, then equal mean/median over shots
input_contract.target_mapping: existing post-cold20 density_gain mapping; radiation gains=1, offsets=0; applied retrospectively to cold20 only for shared coordinates
input_contract.qualification: finite raw features; no /meta, outcome, event, post-termination or risk-based filter
input_contract.source_split: canonical index train/val arrays only; TEST section not read

interpretation: Unlabelled reconstruction MAE is not first-alarm performance, timely-detection benefit, false-alarm rate, or safety evidence. Cold20 is a retrospective diagnostic under the already fixed later map; no change to historical cold-start behavior is implied.
